messages:
nat_support: Escalated P1 from Keystone Biotech onboarding. Multiple QA users hitting 403 on token exchange after SSO. Ticket SUP-5012. Theyre mid-onboarding and contract renewal in ~28 days. Need CS comms + urgent mitigation.

nat_support: Error example: 2024-08-01T09:18:44Z ERROR auth: token-exchange failed status=403 body={\"error\":\"ExchangeTokenFailed\"} request_id=7b9f

maria_cs: Thanks Nat. I'm taking CSM lead. Can AE confirm impact scope? Also want a one-line customer update we can send in 30 mins.

sara_ae: On call now with their IT lead. Affects ~6 power-users (admins) blocking product setup. Sponsor concerned about onboarding schedule. I'll join triage & send a quick note after we confirm mitigation.

rong_se: I'll do a guided repro with one of their admins and capture raw SAML and token-exchange payloads. Suggest trying cookie clear + incognito while we look.

leo_infra: Looking at metrics: small burst of 502s to token-service earlier, then 403s for this tenant. I can temporarily route token-exchange for this tenant to an alternate instance (bypass cache) while we patch. Low risk toggle. Need CS/AE OK to change tenant-level routing.

maria_cs: Approve temporary routing toggle. We'll message customer immediately that we have a mitigation, will run a 30m repro session, and will follow up with RCA. Draft update: "We're tracking a token-exchange error blocking some admin logins. We've enabled a temporary routing workaround and will validate on a brief call. Expect an update within 1 hour."

incident_bot: [action] tenant-routing-bypass enabled for tenant=keystone-biotech by leo_infra at 2024-08-01T09:45:12Z

nat_support: Customer confirmed one admin could resume setup after workaround. Updating SUP-5012.

sara_ae: Sent sponsor note: confirmed temporary fix and RCA promised within 48 hours. Will escalate to sales lead if they press on contract items.

rong_se: Captured failing token service response: {"error":"invalid_grant","detail":"mismatched_client_id"} for some assertions. Adding to ticket.

leo_infra: Monitoring after toggle: errors dropped for tenant. I'll create JIRA for token-service client mapping bug and link SUP-5012.

maria_cs: Action items:
- maria_cs: send 30-min customer update and meeting invite
- leo_infra: schedule permanent patch JIRA + owner
- rong_se: run enablement/repro session and document playbook
- sara_ae: follow up with sponsor on renewal reassurance
- nat_support: consolidate logs/screenshots in SUP-5012 and mark P1->escalated-to-cs

maria_cs: Final: I sent the customer update at 10:05 PT, copied into the ticket. Will post RCA link here when ready. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
